Bounded URI segment end offsets (QUA-RGL-001) and full boxed-inline array allocation (QUA-RGL-002). Translation offset bounds (QUA-RGL-003), Send-bound task results (QUA-RGL-004), and cancelled task completion/sender finalization (QUA-RGL-005). Log field byte lifetime (QUA-RGL-006), flag union semantics (QUA-RGL-007), StrV terminators and equality lengths (QUA-RGL-008/009), and parent-owned spawn callbacks (QUA-RGL-010). GStringPtr ownership transfer, foreign byte lengths, and owned string-vector GValue conversion (QUA-R02-011/012/013). URI decoded UTF-8 validation (QUA-RGL-011) and aborted FusedFuture termination consistency (QUA-RGL-005 review follow-up).
